results.title: Granada Hills Volleyball Advances in State Playoffs with Victory Over Tustin
results.description: The Granada Hills varsity volleyball team defeated Tustin in a tense five-set battle during the opening round of the CIF State Division IV playoffs. Freshman setter Jazleen Puente earned her first varsity start alongside junior Weiwei Gao, helping secure a win and setting up a quarterfinal matchup against rival Chatsworth.

results.title: Rockets' Marcus Smart ejected for throwing punch at Warriors' Charles Bassey
results.description: Rockets guard Marcus Smart threw a right hook Wednesday night that grazed the nose of Warriors center Charles Bassey in the third quarter of Houston's win.
